hypotheses.D0_native_gate_patches_are_exact: Native patches reproduce every layer's finite effect and final answer coordinates at fidelity at least 0.9999.
hypotheses.D1_semantic_answer_quotient_emerges_only: Selected answer-centroid fidelity is below 0.60 at Layers 0-2 and above 0.90 at Layer 3 in every run.
hypotheses.D2_rank64_dense_bottleneck_is_sufficient: Rank-64 PCA reaches at least 0.80 selected fidelity at every layer and run.
hypotheses.D3_dense_axes_beat_native_coordinates_th: Rank-64 PCA exceeds the matched native-coordinate subspace by at least 0.15 at every layer and run.
hypotheses.D4_causal_dimension_contracts_with_depth: The tested rank needed for 0.90 selected fidelity is nonincreasing with depth and strictly smaller at Layer 3 than Layer 0 in every run.
hypotheses.D5_arbitrary_complexity_is_visible_early: At Layer 0 or 1, selected rank-32 fidelity is at least 0.05 below unselected rank-32 fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.D6_rank64_pca_beats_random_subspaces: Rank-64 PCA exceeds random-rank-64 p95 by at least 0.15 at every layer, status, and run.
hypotheses.D7_template_transfer_is_stable: Selected rank-64 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates everywhere.
hypotheses.D8_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
